name: morandi-cinematic-poster-zeejay
title_zh: 把场景收成莫兰迪电影海报
tagline_zh: 低饱和、一层雾，场面压成电影静帧
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied personal photograph into a source-faithful, typography-driven Morandi cinematic poster without stars or decorative collage symbols. Use film-poster title design, optional poetic byline and tagline, atmospheric metadata, optional fictional credits, intentional negative-space placement, perspective alignment, and selective subject occlusion. why_zh: 不是「生成一张海报」，是把搜集来的场面压成一种固定的电影静帧：低饱和、一层雾、像印在纸上。
limit_zh: 风格锁死在莫兰迪电影静帧。要热闹大片、要品牌 VI、要多风格切换，这件会把你按回去。
